mapper.sql: SELECT p.partner_id, p.partner_name, p.partner_image_url, c.category_id, c.pre_category_id, c.category_name, c.category_image_url FROM partner p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.partner_id, p.partner_name, p.partner_image_url, c.category_name FROM partner p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.partner_id = #{partnerId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_partner ( benefit_id, partner_id, last_modified_at ) VALUES ( #{benefitId}, #{partnerId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT partner_id, category_id, partner_name, partner_image_url, is_deleted, created_at, deleted_at, last_modified_at FROM partner WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId} AND is_deleted = false
